name: E-SUPPORTLINK,Ltd.
summary: E-SUPPORTLINK, Ltd., established in Tokyo, Japan, in 1998, offers technology and services for the fresh produce supply chain. Its products include the e Support link online platform for exchanging distribution information, Fresh MD, a cloud service for ordering and payment of perishables, and farm story, an IT solution for growers. Customers include producers, cooperatives, government agencies, distributors and retailers.
